data.name: Disruptive (Mythic)
data.description: You're a master at disrupting nearby spellcasters. The DC to cast spells defensively within your threatened area increases by . This stacks with the increase granted by Disruptive. In addition, even if you can't make attacks of opportunity, non-mythic spellcasters are still wary of you and continue to suffer from the effects of Disruptive.
